connect.title: Connect to a device
connect.resetOnConnectHint: Same behavior as the Arduino IDE. Turn off if your board resets in a way that loses the first lines you care about.
connect.portBusy: The port is in use by another program. Close the Arduino IDE Serial Monitor (or any other program using it) and try again.
connect.disconnectToFlashHint: Frees the port so the Arduino IDE (or another uploader) can use it. Reconnects automatically once the board reappears, if auto-reconnect is on.

statusBar.protocolErrorsHint: Filter the console to protocol errors only

console.title: Console
console.sendPlaceholder: Send a line to the device…

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoReconnect: Reconnect automatically when a known device reappears
settings.autoDiscovery: Auto-create a widget for undeclared channels
settings.clearLocalDataConfirm: This removes all locally stored settings, port permissions memory, and history from this browser. This cannot be undone. Continue?

unsupported.title: This browser can't talk to a serial port
unsupported.body: SerialDash needs the Web Serial API to connect to real hardware, and your current browser doesn't support it.
unsupported.browserList: Supported browsers: Chrome, Edge, Opera, and Brave, on Windows, macOS, Linux, or ChromeOS.
unsupported.stillUseful: You can still explore SerialDash without a serial connection:
unsupported.replayComingSoon: Replay a recording (coming in a later milestone)

addWidgetDialog.title: Add widget
addWidgetDialog.controlIdHint: Controls bind by id, not by channel — only ids without a widget of their own are listed.
addWidgetDialog.controlNoTargets: Every control the device exposes already has its own widget.
